# Synthetic Node execution wire fixture

Generated by the Node repository's `scripts/check_physical_execution.py` for
TIN-405. It invokes the real local registry, released Runtime router, SQLite run
store and execution service with the explicitly simulated transfer provider.
No hardware, camera, real discovery or model inference is involved.

The source artifact SHA-256 is
`0c1740800aae1d8c2832a6ff661ffbc4900d20e6d1b6307de5b91ac2f4f9e4f0`.
This checked-in copy normalizes line endings and adds a final newline; its
SHA-256 is `d8ff31e47d948833116f0e218ee6d819af5df72777522de11832b7de43e6e000`.
The decoder checks the authentic nested run, snapshot and receipt digests,
including Python floating-point event timestamps. Historical approval expiry
is intentional: this fixture proves contract decoding, not live permission.
The snapshot version is `physicalsystems-run-snapshot-v1`; it references a
shared immutable configuration snapshot by digest instead of duplicating the
configuration inside every run. The operator receipt view validates the outer
snapshot integrity; resolving and checking referenced configuration/artifact
content remains Node-owned.
